      (fun lst f prev currLen maxLen =>
        (match (motive := (lst : List Int) → List.below (motive := fun lst => Option Int → Nat → Nat → Nat) lst → Nat)
            lst with
          | [] => fun x => max currLen maxLen
          | x :: xs => fun x_1 =>
            match prev with
            | none => x_1.1 (some x) 1 (max 1 maxLen)
            | some p =>
              if x > p then x_1.1 (some x) (currLen + 1) (max (currLen + 1) maxLen)
              else x_1.1 (some x) 1 (max currLen maxLen))
          f)
      none 0 0 =
    List.brecOn (motive := fun lst => Option Int → Nat → Nat → Nat) nums
      (fun lst f prev currLen maxLen =>
        (match (motive := (lst : List Int) → List.below (motive := fun lst => Option Int → Nat → Nat → Nat) lst → Nat)
            lst with
          | [] => fun x => max currLen maxLen
          | x :: xs => fun x_1 =>
            match prev with
            | none => x_1.1 (some x) 1 (max 1 maxLen)
            | some p =>
              if x > p then x_1.1 (some x) (1 + currLen) (max (currLen + 1) maxLen)
              else x_1.1 (some x) 1 (max currLen maxLen))
          f)
      none 0 0
